events.title: Does the Monastery rental fee include all the services needed to host an event?
events.description: This fee covers the space only. However, the Monastery arranges all the other services needed for your event (catering, decoration, entertainment, etc.).

time_limit.title: Is there a time limit for an event?
time_limit.description: Yes. Events last 12 hours and are expected to end by 04:00, with the option of an additional hour.

travel.title: Is it easy to reach Mosteiro de Landim?
travel.description2: , 30 minutes from Porto and 20 minutes from Porto airport.

per_weekend.title: When is the Monastery open for events?
per_weekend.description: The Monastery is open to any kind of event throughout the year.
